I2C servo driver board. Generates hardware PWM for MG996R servos. I2C Bus 1, addr 0x40 (TF-Luna is 0x10, no conflict). Required because Yahboom carrier GPIO PWM pins are dead (ECO-2026-008).
50W capacity, fully potted/waterproof. Isolated servo power — prevents Jetson brownout from MG996R stall current (up to 2.5A each). GND must tie to Jetson GND for PWM signal reference.

180° positional digital servos, full metal gears, 10-13 kg·cm torque. 2 needed (pan + tilt), 4 spares. Replaces Storm32 brushless gimbal — mechanical gear locking provides holding torque against water hose tension.

column7: Switches the 12V/2A GOODRIG solenoid. Logic-level (3.3-20V trigger) — driven by BCM 27 / T13 via libgpiod; replaces the failed bare IRLB8721 MOSFET (no fragile gate, runs cold). Wiring: SIG←green, DC IN +/−←12V/GND, OUT +/−→solenoid, common GND. See eco004_mosfet_module_option.drawio.
3A flyback across the 12V/2A solenoid coil (band/cathode → +12V / OUT+ side). Heavier than the 1N4007 — needed for the 2A inductive load. The dual-MOS module has no built-in load flyback.
